subject: Evidence dry-run logistics & scope questions
messages:
From: BrightAudit LLP <onboarding@brightaudit.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Acme Security <security@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Evidence dry-run & scoping questions

Hi Rachel / Acme team,

Thanks for engaging BrightAudit for the upcoming evidence dry-run. To make the session productive wed like to confirm scope and prep items up front. Our initial asks below — please let us know if anything is out of scope or needs sanitization.

1) High-level scope we recommend: CAIQ + SIG mapping, ISO 27001 Annex A controls (A.8, A.9, A.12), and a sampling of FedRAMP-relevant controls (AC-2/3, IA-2, CM-3).
2) Evidence well request during the dry-run: access control lists, change management tickets with approvals, configuration management snapshots, KMS key rotation logs, recent SOC 2 test artifacts (if available), and sample audit/production log extracts.
3) Format: we can accept redacted logs and screenshots for PII-sensitive material; please confirm retention windows for logs you plan to share.
4) Timing: propose a 60-min dry-run week of 2026-09-14.

Attachments: BrightAudit-Kickoff-Checklist.pdf (high level items well validate).

Point of contact on our side: Jenna Morales (onboarding@brightaudit.com). If youd like a short pre-call to align on control owner availability, we can schedule 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Jenna Morales
Engagement Lead, BrightAudit LLP

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Evidence dry-run & scoping questions

Jenna — thanks, this looks good and aligned with what we were expecting. Quick confirmations and a proposed plan from our side: 

- Scope confirmation: CAIQ + SIG, ISO 27001 Annex A (well prioritize A.9 - Access Control, A.12 - Operations), and a focused FedRAMP subset. Well flag any controls we deem out of scope ahead of the dry-run.
- Evidence index: attaching our preliminary index (RI_evidence_index_v1.xlsx) and a CAIQ->SIG mapping doc (RI_CAQ_SIG_mapping.docx). These are working documents — expect updates after control-owner intake.
- Log extracts: production redaction is required. We can provide sanitized logs and schema exports; final raw extracts would require auditor NDA and a short access window.
- Retention windows: most infra logs are 90 days on hot storage, 365 days in long-term retention. Well note exceptions in the evidence index.
- Proposed dry-run: 2026-09-16 10:00–11:00 PT. If that works for you well reserve the calendar and confirm control owners for the slots.

Pre-reads and links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3evidenceindex (evidence index v1) and HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-987

Attachments: RI_evidence_index_v1.xlsx, RI_CAQ_SIG_mapping.docx

--

Thanks Rachel / Jenna — a few clarifying points from engineering/security ahead of the dry-run: 

- Please confirm whether the dry-run will require sanitized production log extracts or if schema-only (field lists + sample rows) is acceptable. For production extracts well need a documented request with purpose and an NDA signed (we can provide a DocuSign link).
- For KMS artifacts we can provide rotation policy and key metadata. Actual key material will never be shared.
- Change management: we can pull a small set of closed RFCs (2-3) that include approval history; specify timeframe (we propose last 90 days).
- Control owners: Ill coordinate owner availability (mostly infra, platform, and SRE). If you need specific ticket IDs or hostnames for the dry-run please ask now so we can pre-filter.

Hi Rachel / Olga,

Thanks for the fast turnaround. 2026-09-16 10:00–11:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Agenda well follow: 1) Introductions & scope, 2) Walk the evidence index live, 3) Request a few sample artifacts (well note what we review), 4) Next steps / remaining gaps.

Pre-reads we need by EOD 2026-09-14: filled CAIQ worksheet (spreadsheet rows for critical controls), assertion matrix mapping ISO/FedRAMP/SIG, and a signed NDA for access to any unredacted items.
